name: Workflow Card
description: A compact project card that unfolds into grouped checklists with soft spring motion, progress rings, status selection and teammate filters.
summary: A single theme-synced project card with a soft, interruptible reveal, coordinated status picker, gliding task highlights, segmented progress and animated teammate selection. Includes live content, layout and motion controls.
highlights: Compact-to-expanded reveal with a measured shell and coordinated status picker
Classic spring defaults: stiffness 105, damping 24, mass 1
Segmented progress ring and reversible checkbox draw animation
Four independent workflow statuses with native keyboard-accessible radio selection
Teammate filters highlight assigned tasks without changing their order
Grouped checklists, inherited light/dark themes and adjustable density, size and corners
Controlled or uncontrolled state, callbacks and scoped GSAP cleanup
Gliding task hover highlight and a subtle increase in ring opacity on hover
Stable header and checklist alignment during opening, closing, selecting and deselecting
anatomy: <header> (Progress ring, expansion triggers, status and teammate filters)

physics.description: GSAP owns playback, using the existing Motion spring solver for the reveal. Shell and status-picker heights animate together from their current positions; hover, checkbox and selection feedback animate without shifting text.

accessibility.aria: Named article, aria-expanded and aria-controls on disclosure buttons, inert collapsed content, aria-checked task buttons, aria-pressed teammate filters and polite announcements.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Height, progress and task updates apply immediately when reduced motion is requested; content remains fully usable.

keyboard.description: Move through expansion, status, teammate and task controls.
Move between native status radio options.
Close the status selector and restore status focus, or collapse the card and focus its progress button.

recommended: Compact project summaries and task dashboards
bestPractices: Use stable section, task and teammate IDs.
Provide onSectionsChange when passing controlled sections.
Keep workflow status independent of checklist completion when a review phase is needed.
Supply onOpen to navigate or display project details.
Use the default 105/24 physics for a smooth reveal with very little bounce.
Set openOnHover to false for an explicit disclosure-only interface.

props.name: title
props.description: Project title.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting text above the checklists.

props.name: dueDate
props.description: Display label for the deadline.

props.name: sections
props.description: Controlled grouped checklists; task IDs must be unique within each section.

props.name: defaultSections
props.description: Initial grouped checklists in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onSectionsChange
props.description: Receives updated sections when a task is toggled.

props.name: assignees
props.description: Team members with stable IDs, names and optional colors. Click to highlight their tasks.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled status: todo, progress, review or done. Independent of task completion.

props.name: defaultStatus
props.description: Initial status for uncontrolled usage.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when a status is selected.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Controlled expansion state.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial expansion state.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Called when expansion is requested by hover, focus or a button.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Reveal on hover and keyboard focus; touch users use the title or ring button.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay before closing after pointer/focus leaves, in seconds.

props.name: theme
props.description: Inherits the website CSS theme tokens by default; optional explicit light or dark override.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent for focus rings and fallback teammate colors.

props.name: width
props.description: Preferred width, clamped to 260–480px and constrained by the parent.

props.name: radius
props.description: Surface corner radius, clamped to 8–28px.

props.name: density
props.description: Checklist row height, 28 or 34px.

props.name: stiffness
props.description: Spring tension, clamped to 60–240. The default has a soft, classic feel.

props.name: damping
props.description: Spring friction, clamped to 14–36. Higher values reduce overshoot.

props.name: duration
props.description: Reveal duration in seconds, clamped to 0.3–1.2.

props.name: showAssignees
props.description: Show teammate filter buttons.

props.name: showDueDate
props.description: Show the deadline label.

props.name: showFooter
props.description: Show completion summary and the open/close action.

props.name: showSectionLabels
props.description: Show section names and completion counts.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional article classes.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Connect the footer Open action to project details. Without it, the footer closes the card.
